summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] entry in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(), which buffers the control only when is_terminal and returns True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title) once per control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing was run, so the tests and Black formatting are unverified. Nothing was committed.
